# The beehave process dies during the implement step, after the agent named its session. The next beehave run
# resumes that session with the short continue prompt, in place of a fresh start with the note.
env REPO=o/r BASE=integration OWNER_LOGIN=owner OWNER_EMAIL=owner@example.com SOURCE_CHECKOUT=/own/checkout
! exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star &
waitfile started
waitsession s-lost
kill -KILL
wait

exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tmerge: merged'

# The replay of the implement step got the resume flag with the saved id, once, and the continue prompt in place of the brief and the note.
# The fix round resumes the implementer as the example says, which is now the session s-lost too.
grep -count=1 '^implement --resume s-lost$' resumes.log
grep -count=1 '^fix --resume s-lost$' resumes.log
grep 'Continue the step from where you stopped' resumed.log
! grep 'step=implement' resumed.log
! grep 'Read `git status`' resumed.log

grep -count=1 '^plan ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^implement ' calls.log

-- hang --
implement
-- hang-session --
s-lost
-- verdicts --
approve
approve
